title: Support of a cone over a current supported in a closed ball
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, R ∈ ℝ, X ∈ D_m(ℝ^P) = GeometricCurrentOn univ m and C ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) = GeometricCurrentOn univ (m+1) with spt X ⊆ B̄_R(0) and Cone(X, C), i.e. C(ω) = X(ψ) whenever ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P), ψ ∈ D^m(ℝ^P) and ψ(x)(v) = ∫_0^1 t^m ω(tx)(x, v) dt for all x in some open set N ⊇ spt X and all v ∈ (ℝ^P)^m ((x, v) := Fin.cons x v). Then spt C ⊆ B̄_R(0).
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), X.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R → (∀ (ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)) (ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) m), (∃ N : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen N ∧ X.support ⊆ N ∧ ∀ x ∈ N, ∀ v : Fin m → Eucl P, (ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) m) x v = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, t ^ m * (ω : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) (m + 1)) (t • x) (Fin.cons x v)) → C ω = X ψ) → C.support ⊆ closedBall 0 R
